text_block_list.text:
While having a brief after-school chat 
with Air Messiah, whom I happened to run 
into in the hallway...
Ah, there she is! Goddess Messiah~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yappie. You free right now?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'm all right, but...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Check it! Got a brand-new tail hole cut! 
Couldja give it a look-see, 'kay?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Um, in short... You're doing your usual 
outfit check?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yup yup. Thanks a bunch~!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I see. You changed the decorations. ...The 
tail hole is within regulations, and the 
stitching is very solid.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. I think this should be fine. It 
looks very lovely."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Alright! Tanks a bunch, Messiah-god!
choice_data_list: Um, what was that just now...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hm? A deity check. I'm having my school 
rules checked.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Messiah-sama's godly checks are seriously 
god-tier! Wanna hear about it!? It's a 
god-level story☆

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"No good! That's against school 
regulations!"

text_block_list.name: Helios & Jordan
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Seriously? Look at this, y'know? Not even 
a tiny bit?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"No good! Tail accessories like that count 
as 'excessive ornamentation'!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Aww, man... Major bummer... Our plan for 
an ultra-hype, stylish race is totally 
ruined~!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Um...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Regarding the decorations, instead of 
beads and chains, could we use ribbons and 
felt balls instead?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Fue?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"『Gaudy decorations on uniforms are 
prohibited as a general rule.』 According 
to the Chairwoman, this rule exists to 
prevent accidentally injuring others in 
daily life."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
So, if there's no danger of that, then it 
shouldn't be an issue.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... True, there's no problem with that 
then! Even if it accidentally hits 
someone, it won't hurt!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Still, that's awesome that you remembered 
the school rules! Color me impressed!

text_block_list.name: Helios & Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, God?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—A divine portion-check performed by a 
god. That's what a 'God Check' is all 
about.

Impressed to learn there was such a reason 
behind the school rule, I turned my 
attention to Air Messiah.
choice_data_list:
Don't tell me you've memorized all the 
school rules?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I read through it many times before 
enrolling, so I probably know most of it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
See? Total god tier. I'd normally give up 
on stuff like that after three letters.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"The guardian deity of our mega-sized 
life! Salute to the God-chu!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
No... um, it's really not something that 
deserves so much praise.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, the 'gal-style press-on 
nails' you gave me the other day were far 
more amazing."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. As a thank-you for the "God Check," I 
was given something truly wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I was truly surprised to hear it was 
handmade. I believe people possessing such 
skill are truly worthy of respect.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aha. Ya like it? ...Well then, wanna go 
full gal next time? I can teach ya nails, 
makeup, anything!
choice_data_list:
Seems like it'll be a great learning 
experience.

I at least want to know what skills they 
have!

I'd at least like to know what skills they 
have!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aha. Ya like it? ...Well then, wanna go 
full gal next time? I can teach ya nails, 
makeup, anything!
choice_data_list:
Seems like it'll be a great learning 
experience.

I at least want to know what skills they 
have!

I'd at least like to know what skills they 
have!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"The 'par' stands for 'party'~. And 'pee' 
is short for 'people'!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I see. ...Could 'pu' perhaps mean 'punpun' 
(pouting)?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
What's that? Like, "I'm totally pooped~" 
vibes? That's freaking hilarious.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, when you think gyaru, you gotta go 
'over the top' first, right? So let's go 
all out☆

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I-I see. ...Will I really be able to pull 
this off?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"All good, all good! Our sense is 
straight-up god-tier☆"
